other_failure_modes.name: Leakage via frequency encoding before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes frequency encoding on the combined train and test dataset before splitting. This leaks the distribution of the test set categories into the training features.

summary: The agent correctly formulates the regression problem and implements a solid 5-fold cross-validation loop with LightGBM. However, it fails to perform any explicit data cleaning and only uses a single evaluation metric. Most critically, it introduces data leakage by computing frequency encodings on the combined train and test set before splitting, allowing test distribution statistics to influence training features.
